tool_args.rationale: Five observations span both input magnitude and sink gradient, and the pilot signatures match a concave two-layer siphon with gradient inhibition. Fit the three-parameter base-plus-local-square-root-branch model numerically. The earlier execution error arose because predict referenced an undefined training-data global; this implementation stores fitted parameters during fit and uses them in predict.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The current rows already span sink-gradient values substantially and support fitting the square-root branch coefficient; no stated branch-probe trigger applies.
The evidence indicates a monotone concave field with sink-gradient dependence, not a coupled memory ODE requiring a longer trajectory batch.
It ignores the clearly varying sink gradient and would not represent the observed sink-gradient signature.
